# Lucide icon subset

This directory vendors 385 SVG icons from [Lucide](https://lucide.dev/), pinned from
commit `03eae6069edfc373673bd05d723491f05ba936e3` of
`lucide-icons/lucide` on 12 November 2026.

The curated subset covers wellbeing, water, nature, science, commerce, shipping,
security, people and navigation. Icons are rendered inline by the application so
their `currentColor` styling follows the surrounding component.

See `LICENSE` for the ISC licence and the included Feather MIT notice.
